title: Add bulk memory status/confidence migration wizard
description:
## Human Auditing Recommendation 3

### Problem
MemorySmith has a `Status` field (Core/Working/Unconsolidated/Deprecated) and a `Confidence` field (0.0-1.0), but there is no tool to migrate groups of records between statuses or update confidence ranges in bulk. A human auditor who identifies 50 Unconsolidated records that should be promoted to Working must edit each one.

### Suggested Implementation
A "Maintenance > Bulk Update" wizard with:
1. Query/filter panel — select records by status, tags, confidence range, date range
2. Preview — show matching record count and sample records before applying
3. Action selection:
   - Set status: dropdown (preserve/downgrade/promote)
   - Set confidence: min/max range or explicit value
   - Add/remove tags: comma-separated additions and removals
4. Dry-run mode that shows what would change without committing
5. Confirmation with count of records affected and summary of changes

### Why It Helps Human Auditing
Status hygiene (promoting Working→Core, archiving Deprecated) and confidence recalibration are recurring audit activities. A wizard makes them safe and fast instead of error-prone individual edits.

### Confidence: 70%
